changes: Remove destination image invalidation before Rasterizer::CopyBuffer acquires/preserves its destination. Early dirty marking made eligible pending images non-downloadable, losing untouched bytes on partial copies.

Centralize image invalidation after BufferCache::ObtainBuffer publishes pending eligible images and synchronizes the buffer, for all writable aliases. Preserve the existing batched-copy path by invalidating the exact ranges at MarkRegionAsGpuModified.
Invalidate all images whose memory overlaps the write interval, including interior writes and images separated by gaps. Ignore empty intervals and preserve non-overlapping neighbours.
Add bounded image-buffer-write diagnostics. No per-title/shader/vendor options or new exceptions. Existing image-publication eligibility remains.
